description: This file contains the implementation of the Product model in the OpenCart system, providing methods for retrieving product data, categories, attributes, and handling product querying functionalities.

classes.name: Product
classes.description: The Product class extends the Engine Model and provides methods to retrieve detailed product information, categories, attributes, and supports complex product filtering and caching.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Product model, setting up query statement templates and dependencies.

methods.name: getProduct
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific product by its ID, including computed prices and reviews.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Fetches a list of products based on filter criteria, supports sorting, pagination, and caching.

methods.name: getCategories
methods.description: Returns categories associated with a given product ID.

methods.name: getCategoriesByCategoryId
methods.description: Returns category relation details for a specific product and category ID.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Retrieves attributes grouped by attribute groups for a given product.

methods.name: getOptions
methods.description: Gets options for a given product ID, including option values with their details.

methods.name: getDiscounts
methods.description: Retrieves discount data for a specified product ID, considering customer group and quantity.

methods.name: getImages
methods.description: Returns images associated with a specific product, ordered by sort order.

methods.name: getSubscription
methods.description: Fetches subscription information for a product and a specified subscription plan.

methods.name: getSubscriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all subscription options linked to a product.

methods.name: getLayoutId
methods.description: Gets the layout ID assigned to a product based on store configuration.

methods.name: getRelated
methods.description: Fetches related products for a given product, including their details like name, image, discounts, specials, rewards, reviews, etc.

methods.name: getTotalProducts
methods.description: Calculates total number of products matching filtering conditions, such as categories, filters, search terms, manufacturer, etc.

methods.name: getSpecials
methods.description: Retrieves products marked as special, considering store and customer group, with optional filtering and sorting.

methods.name: getTotalSpecials
methods.description: Returns the total count of special products available based on current store and customer group context.

methods.name: addReport
methods.description: Inserts a report entry for a product, recording IP address, country, and timestamp.
